lines.text: The Israelites observed the Passover in the Wilderness of Sinai at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month.
Moses told them to wait, and the LORD said those unclean from a dead body or traveling could still keep Passover.
They were to eat the lamb on the fourteenth day of the seventh month, with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
A clean man not traveling who skipped Passover was to be stoned, and a willing foreigner follows the same statute.
